logp.method_description: The logarithm of the partition coefficient (LogP) for AuL10 was determined according to the following procedure. 100 mL of water (distilled after Milli-Q purification) and 100 mL of 1-octanol were stirred together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. Five standard solutions of complexes were prepared in the 1-octanol phase and other five in the water phase (20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 μM), and a calibration curve (absorbance vs concentration) was obtained using UV/vis spectroscopy. A further solution of both complexes was prepared in a 1-octanol phase (50 μM) and an equal volume of water was added. The biphasic solutions were mixed for 20 min and then centrifuged for 1 h at 6500 rpm to allow separation. Concentration in each phase was determined by UV/Vis. LogP was calculated using the following formula: log[complex]oct/[complex]H2O. logP = 1.23.
